q: How does xsv search filter rows?
task: A teammate thinks xsv search rewrites the CSV in place. How does xsv search apply the given regex across fields in each row, and when there is a match what exactly is written to the output?

must_not: select narrows output to searched columns only
task: You only want to match against two columns but keep whole rows. Which search flag limits the columns searched, and when a limited search matches is the output the full row or only the searched columns?

q: When do you pass -i to search?
task: Your pattern must match regardless of case. Which xsv search flag enables case insensitive search, which regex prefix is it equivalent to, and which builder call applies it?

q: When do you pass -v to search?
task: You need every row that does NOT contain the pattern. Which xsv search flag selects only rows that did not match, what is its short spelling, and which args field flips the match?

q: How do you reference columns in select?
task: You must pick the first and fourth columns, then the first four by name. How can xsv select reference columns by index versus by header name, and which dash form expresses a column range?

q: How do you drop leading columns?
task: You must ignore the first two columns of a wide CSV. Which two xsv select spellings drop leading columns, one by open-ended range and one by omission with a bang prefix?

q: How do you pick one duplicate column?
task: Your header has three columns all named Foo and one name with a dash that collides with selector syntax. How do you select the third Foo and how do you quote a conflicting column name?

q: How do headers and delimiters work?
task: Your CSV has no header row and uses a semicolon. Which two common flags declare no headers and a custom delimiter, what must the delimiter be, and what is the default delimiter?
From the repo root run rg -n invert work/xsv-csv/src/search.rs. Paste the three match lines, state their line numbers, and name the flag that selects only rows that did not match.

From the repo root run rg -n SelectColumns work/xsv-csv/src/search.rs work/xsv-csv/src/select.rs. Paste the four match lines, state their line numbers, and name the args field that carries the column selection in each file.
From the repo root run rg -n no-headers work/xsv-csv/src/search.rs. Paste the match line, state its line number, and quote what the flag declares about the first row.

q: Run rg file list for select
task: From the repo root run rg -l select work/xsv-csv/src/. Paste both file lines, state which two files use select, and name which one implements row filtering versus column projection.
